_comment: The tests that may skip in CI, each with the run it skips in and its reason. In CI (CI=true) every other skip fails the job: in pytest runs through pinka_repo_checks.skip_policy, in the Python 3.9 unittest runs of make test-py39 through pinka_repo_checks.unittest_run. Keep it empty or nearly so: a test that can run in CI runs there.

skips.reason: the Python 3.9 run is standard library only, so the reference jsonschema validator is not there; the pytest run of the same test compares with it
